meaning: Household, parents and children family unit.
hand_configuration: Both hands form 'F' or cupped handshapes with fingertips touching at midline, then circling outward and touching wrists together to represent a complete household circle.
isl_grammar_structure: Collective noun; acts as discourse topic in social introductions (e.g. MY FAMILY BIG).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Central concept in Indian social communication; implies deep community and familial bonds.

media.description: Both hands tracing an outward circle touching fingertips and wrists representing an enclosed family unit.
